title: AC1018 TABLE multi-row plain-text codec

authority.source: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.relevantRule: The pre-R24 TABLE body stores the number of rows, repeats row heights for the declared count, and repeats cell data for all n by m cells.

implementation.summary: The private AC1018 direct TABLE codec now supports one column and multiple plain-text rows, bounded by the existing TABLE row limit. Preflight requires rowcount to match the model, each row to contain exactly one default-profile text cell, and each row height and cell to pass the existing refusal checks. Encoding emits all row heights, then cells in row order, and one cell value-handle slot plus any text-style override handle for each row. The TABLE parser now copies decoded column/row counts into the inherited count fields. Public dwgRW::writeTable remains refused.

coverage: Generated two-row, one-column AC1018 TABLE body
Fresh typed readback of row count, row heights, cell text order and exact body boundary
Second-row hard-pointer text-style override handle follows the per-cell handle slot
Destination-preserving refusal when a row lacks exactly one supported cell
Existing single-cell override, truncation, handle-role and atomic-retry controls

limitations: Generated encoder/parser self-consistency only; no physical AC1018 producer witness or independent-reader result is established.
Only one-column text-cell tables are admitted; multi-column, block, FIELD, attribute, merge, linked-data and unsupported override profiles remain refused.
The codec remains private experimental coverage and is not connected to public dwgRW::writeTable.
The anonymous *T block graph, compound transaction, physical source-to-output proof, native rendering and broad support claims remain open.
nextAction: Continue the remaining direct-codec model audit and use an eligible physical AC1018 source to establish body compatibility before implementing the *T compound graph or enabling public TABLE output.
